mapper.sql: p.pos_id as positionId,p.pos_title as title,c.cmp_id as companyId,c.cmp_name as company, p.pos_work_city as city,p.pos_salary_min as salaryMin,p.pos_salary_max as salaryMax, p.pos_experience_required as experience,p.pos_education_required as education
mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select from t_pos p join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id=p.pos_company_id where p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and p.pos_status=1 and c.cmp_status=1 and p.pos_title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') order by p.pos_id desc limit 20 offset #{offset}
select from t_pos p join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id=p.pos_company_id where p.pos_id=#{positionId} and p.pos_company_id=#{companyId} and p.pos_status=1 and c.cmp_status=1 for update
select u.user_id from sys_user u where u.user_id=#{peerId} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and exists(select 1 from t_tal t where t.tal_user_id=u.user_id)

select m.imsg_id as messageId,m.imsg_session_id as sessionId,m.imsg_content as content, case when s.ims_user_a_id=#{userId} then s.ims_user_b_id else s.ims_user_a_id end as peerId from t_im_message m join t_im_session s on s.ims_id=m.imsg_session_id where m.imsg_sender_id=#{userId} and m.imsg_type=6 and json_valid(m.imsg_content) and json_unquote(json_extract(m.imsg_content,'$.kind'))='job_card' and json_unquote(json_extract(m.imsg_content,'$.requestId'))=#{requestId} order by m.imsg_id limit 1
